# Roman Ficnar — Czech walkthrough and controls

- Original source: [Roman Ficnar — Czech walkthrough and controls](https://www.abcgames.cz/?p=navody_zobraz&id=5559)
- Author / publication: Roman Ficnar, credited to Abecedaher.cz / hosted by ABCgames.cz
- Language / date: Czech; date not verified
- Access: Substantial page text inspected through direct HTML retrieval
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

The user-supplied walkthrough includes general tactics, descriptions of all hero and generic recruit types, keyboard shortcuts, minimap colors, camp management, ambush examples, and numbered campaign routes.

General advice emphasizes quiet movement near sentries, searching rooms and bodies, using terrain, binding enemies to improve recruitment, and watching civilians who may report the party. It explains growing suspicion indicators and scheduling coordinated actions, such as simultaneous knockouts by Robin and John.

The mission routes include optional objectives and collectibles, with advice for entering castles and moving a mixed party through passages some characters cannot use.

**Limitations:** its order and numbering differ from other walkthroughs. The opening route appears to confuse Godwin with the servant encountered in his absence. Keyboard labels reflect a Czech layout and should not be transcribed blindly into an English controls reference. The browser initially failed to decode the page; a direct request recovered readable Czech text.
